reddit.question: What’s a good teleprompter app for recording videos on iPhone?
reddit.reply: Look for one that keeps the script close to the lens and lets you control the scroll. If you pause often, voice-paced scrolling can help. I’m working on one with those features; it’s not launched yet.

reddit.question: Any teleprompter apps that don’t put a watermark on recordings?
reddit.reply: Check the free recording terms before you commit—some apps watermark exports or reserve recording for a paid plan. I’m building one with watermark-free recording, coming soon to iPhone.

reddit.question: What’s a simple way to redo one part of a presentation video?
reddit.reply: If your recording setup supports separate section takes, you can redo a flubbed part without restarting the whole script. I’m working on a teleprompter with that workflow; it’s pre-launch.
